title: identity Module
content_markdown: This module adds support for SIP Identity (see RFC 4474).
overview: This module adds support for SIP Identity (see RFC 4474).

exported_parameters.name: privKey
exported_parameters.description: Filename of private RSA-key of authentication service. This file must be in PEM format.

exported_parameters.name: authCert
exported_parameters.description: Filename of certificate which belongs to `privKey`. This file must be in PEM format.

exported_parameters.name: certUri
exported_parameters.description: URI from which the certificate of the authentication service can be acquired. This string will be placed in the Identity-Info header.

exported_parameters.name: verCert
exported_parameters.description: Path containing certificates for the verifier. Certificates must be in PEM format. The URI in the Identity-Info header field is used to find the corresponding certificate for the request. For this purpose the verifier replaces every character which is not alphanumeric, no “\_” and no “.” with a “\-”. A “.” at the beginning of the URI is forbidden. If the URI is “http://www.test.com/cert.pem” the verifier will look for the file “http---www.test.com-cert.pem”, for example. It is also possible to store a whole certificate chain in a file. In this case certificates must be in right order, end certificate first.

exported_parameters.name: caList
exported_parameters.description: File containing all trusted (root) certificates for the verifier. Certificates must be in PEM format.

exported_parameters.name: crlList
exported_parameters.description: File containing certificate revocation lists (crls) for the verifier. Setting this parameter is only necessary if `useCrls` is set to “1”.

exported_parameters.name: useCrls
exported_parameters.description: Switch to decide whether to use revocation lists (“1”) or not (“0”).

exported_functions.name: authservice

return_values.condition: Date header field does not match validity period of cert. Identity header has not been added.
message out of time (e.g. message to old), Identity header has not been added.
everything OK, Identity header has been added.

exported_functions.description: This function performs the steps of an authentication service. Before you call this function, you have to ensure that the server is responsible for this request (from URI matches local SIP domain) and the sender of the request is authorized to claim the identity given in the From header field.

exported_functions.name: verifier

return_values.condition: Signature does not correspond to the message. 438-response should be send.
Certificate cannot be validated. 437-response should be send.
Certificate is not available. 436-response should be send.
Message does not have an Identity header. 428-response should be send.

exported_functions.description: This function performs the steps of an verifier. The returned code tells you the result of the verification.

configuration_examples.title: Example 1.8. authservice() usage
configuration_examples.description:
This function performs the steps of an authentication service. Before you call this function, you have to ensure that

*   the server is responsible for this request (from URI matches local SIP domain)
    
*   the sender of the request is authorized to claim the identity given in the From header field.

configuration_examples.title: Example 1.9. verifier() usage
configuration_examples.description:
This function performs the steps of an verifier. The returned code tells you the result of the verification:

*   -438: Signature does not correspond to the message. 438-response should be send.
    
*   -437: Certificate cannot be validated. 437-response should be send.
    
*   -436: Certificate is not available. 436-response should be send.
    
*   -428: Message does not have an Identity header. 428-response should be send.
    
*   -3: Error verifying Date header field.
    
*   -2: Authentication service is not authoritative.
    
*   -1: An unknown error occurred.
    
*   1: verification OK
